This
Miscellaneous First Appeal Is Filed Under Section 173(1) Of Motor Vehicle Act
Praying To:
a) Call For Records In Mvc No. 427/2016 On The File Of Senior Civil
Judge & Jmfc & Mact At Aurad-B.
b) Allow This Appeal To Modify The Judgment

AND AWARD DATED 30.09.2019 PASSED IN MVC NO. 427/2016 BY THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE &
JMFC & MACT AT AURAD-B AND ENHANCING THE COMPENSATION FROM RS.
85,000/- WITH 6% INTEREST TO RS. 11,00,000/- WITH 12% INTEREST.
c) GRANT SUCH OTHER AND FURTHER RELIEF'S AS THIS HON'BLE COURT DEEMS FIT, IN THE CIRCUMSTANCE OF THE CASE, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR CONCILIATION BEFORE LOK ADALAT, THIS DAY, THE FOLLOWING ORDER IS PASSED:
CONCILIATION ORDER
The learned counsel for the Appellant/Claimant and the representative of Respondent-Insurance Company along with its counsel are present.
2. After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.

The Appellant/Claimant has agreed to receive and the Respondents-Insurance Companies have agreed to pay a global compensation of Rs.80,000/- (Rupees Eighty Thousand only), in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal,
in full and final settlement of the claim.
A joint Memo is filed on behalf of the parties to this effect.
Same is accepted.
3. The entire amount shall be released in favour of the Claimant.
